## Samsung and SK Hynix CEOs Reported Attending Google's AI Camp in Sicily

CEO-level engagement between Google and both dominant HBM suppliers at a closed-door AI strategy event signals demand conversations happening at the top; relevant to supply-chain commitment depth and potential long-term allocation preferences between Samsung and SK Hynix.

- CEOs of both Samsung and SK Hynix are reported to be attending Google's AI Camp in Sicily, per sourced Korean reporting.
- The event is framed around deepening AI ties between the Korean memory leaders and Google.
- CEO-level attendance signals hyperscaler-memory supply-chain relationships are being managed at the highest organizational level.
- Medium classifier confidence reflects sourced but not officially confirmed reporting.
